statement: A caller-supplied admin query deadline is propagated across the websocket request and bounds server-side snapshot observation before the caller expires, while callers that omit a deadline retain the existing default, and the production five-node MovieLens milestone completes schema admission, durable ratings creation, 100000-row preload, ratings-only split convergence, and the successful three-way report.
